messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Bupropion is an antidepressant medication used to treat depression and seasonal affective disorder.
It also supports smoking cessation and weight management.
Bupropion is the active ingredient in Wellbutrin and Zyban.
Auvelity contains bupropion and dextromethorphan.
Contrave contains bupropion and naltrexone.
Bupropion improves mood regulation.
Bupropion improves nicotine cravings.
When combined with naltrexone, bupropion helps reduce food intake.
Bupropion is thought to work by changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain.
These chemicals include noradrenaline and dopamine.
Bupropion first became an FDA-approved medicine on 30 December 1985.
Triplet: ["Bupropion", "is active ingredient in", "Zyban"]

The relation 'is active ingredient in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is the active component or pharmacologically active substance in the product specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
